scope: Observed local completed video experiments; no new inference, GPU run, judge API call, or algorithm/default change.

primary_policy.NExTQA: Maximum recorded WUPS among eligible completed 200-sample,64-frame,10%-ratio,no-correction mainline records.
primary_policy.VATEX: Maximum raw mean(BLEU-4,METEOR,ROUGE-L,CIDEr); table displays all four metrics and the mean multiplied by100 together. CIDEr-only alternatives are separate.
primary_policy.VideoChatGPT: Main table uses output-independent GPT-5.4-mini scoring only, response model gpt-5.4-mini-2026-03-17, five equally weighted metric means. Shared/paired cache and GPT-5.5 remain separate.
primary_policy.single_candidate: A single completed configuration is an evidence-backed candidate, not proof of hyperparameter optimality.

common_constraints.absolute_budget_env: Not universally1024: some Qwen Snap/Mada runs leave BUDGET unset. Per-run evidence takes precedence.
